scope: Development progress. Completed items describe private implementation or the named validation work; the combined pilot is still being integrated.

items.title: Records and evidence foundations
items.detail: Records requests, response gaps, evidence search, source provenance and versioned dossier components are implemented.

items.title: PDF review and correction workflow
items.detail: Source-page citations, explicit match and unread states, one correction round and preserved earlier revisions are implemented in the private pilot.

items.title: Clearer pilot usability
items.detail: A named source-review question, narrow-screen fingerprint wrapping and text labels for OCR progress have passed candidate-specific verification.

items.title: Fictional installed rehearsal
items.detail: The selected private pilot completed an automated Windows journey covering preparation, correction, review-state changes and recipient verification.

items.title: Fictional walkthrough and backup
items.detail: A fictional walkthrough kit was prepared and its independent backup checked. Refreshing it to the final integrated pilot remains ahead.

items.title: Public project presentation
items.detail: The website and GitHub roadmap explain the project, its implemented foundations and its longer-term ambitions.

items.title: Combined pilot delivery
items.detail: Bring the usability, packaging, source-wording and startup changes into one candidate and verify that combined build.

items.title: Windows startup hardening
items.detail: Complete verification and closeout of the startup guard, then integrate it into the combined pilot.

items.title: Packaging and operator guidance
items.detail: Resolve package-builder review findings and clarify the installation and recipient-verification instructions.

items.title: Clean-machine installation
items.detail: Install the final combined package on a clean machine and complete its first-use journey.

items.title: Refresh the demonstration
items.detail: Rebuild the fictional walkthrough against the accepted integrated pilot and check its backup.

items.title: Guided partner evaluations
items.detail: Use fictional samples to learn where onboarding, source inspection and revision review can improve.

items.title: Prepare a runnable release
items.detail: Complete the remaining technical and release work before offering a public product download.
